caption_linkedin:
Faulty product or poor service? Many people don't realise how simple a consumer complaint in India has become.

Under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019:
• Claims up to ₹50 lakh go to the District Consumer Commission (₹50 lakh–₹2 crore to the State Commission)
• There is no filing fee at the District Commission for claims up to ₹5 lakh
• The complaint should be filed within 2 years, and can be filed online on the government's e-Jagriti portal
• The National Consumer Helpline (1915) is a good first step

If you need help drafting or filing a complaint, you can consult a Bar Council-verified advocate on AdvocateSetu: https://advocatesetu.com
